fields.name: Uddhava (disciple of Śyāmānanda, Kasiāḍi)
fields.notes:
He was a disciple of Śyāmānanda Prabhu, of the Śrīpāṭa of Kasiāḍi (Prema-vilāsa 20).

The record also held the Uddhava disciple of Rasikānanda, now in a record of its own (07-11-2026).
He was a disciple of Rasikānanda Prabhu (Rasikamaṅgala Paścima 14.137). Taken out of the record «Uddhava» #1569, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).
